scope: real Win32 reference host (packaged product build) at one source: keyboard only, UI Automation read

jobs.name: real Win32 host UIA and keyboard audit (windows-2022)

audited_binary.name: EXReader.exe
audited_binary.build: EXReaderProduct (product catalog + desktop metadata), packaged with --static-reading

findings.expected: the shelf search box announces an accessible name
findings.fix: give the search box its own window text or provider name (书架搜索)

findings.expected: the comment editor announces an accessible name
findings.actual: name='', control_type='EditControl'; the adjacent static names the list instead
findings.fix: set an accessible name on the multiline edit (标注内容)

findings.expected: page text readable through a Text/Value pattern or child text
findings.actual: patterns=['LegacyIAccessiblePattern'], child_count=0: only the name 阅读区域 is exposed
findings.fix: implement a UI Automation text provider over the painted page text and its selection

findings.element: EXReaderPage served by the default proxy
findings.expected: the custom page view answers with a provider
findings.actual: WM_GETOBJECT=0, UiaReturnRawElementProvider=0, IAccessible=0 in the host sources
findings.fix: implement WM_GETOBJECT on EXReaderPage (UiaReturnRawElementProvider or the MSAA bridge)

findings.expected: focus stays on the activated command or moves to a defined stop
findings.actual: focus='none' right after Space; two Tabs keep it 'none'
findings.fix: in host_update_controls, move focus to the next enabled control before disabling the focused one

findings.expected: Tab and Shift+Tab both leave the comment field
findings.actual: after two Tabs=['note_edit','note_edit']; the same for Shift+Tab
findings.fix: stop answering WM_GETDLGCODE with DLGC_WANTALLKEYS, or forward Tab to IsDialogMessage

findings.expected: each enabled stop once, then back to the first
findings.actual: 20 stops, cycle closed, 7 stops required an audit resume after the trap
findings.fix: clearing KB-07 makes the cycle clean; re-measure afterwards

findings.expected: after Escape the focus is back on 详情
findings.fix: SetFocus the invoking button in the dialog WM_DESTROY; SetActiveWindow alone is not enough

findings.actual: focus='none' right after the import command ran

findings.element: main window commands while the dialog is open
findings.expected: the blocked owner commands report IsEnabled=false
findings.actual: IsWindowEnabled(main)=False but UIA IsEnabled of 导入=True
findings.fix: expose the blocked state through a provider so assistive technology does not offer unusable controls

findings.expected: status changes raise an accessibility event
findings.actual: NotifyWinEvent=0 in the host sources; the status line is a plain static
findings.fix: raise EVENT_OBJECT_NAMECHANGE or a UIA notification from set_status/set_statusf

findings.expected: every dialog command carries an access key
findings.actual: 保存 access_key='Alt+s'; 取消 access_key=''
findings.fix: give 取消 a mnemonic like the other dialog commands

findings.element: no settings window in the host
findings.actual: inline 字号/缩放 commands plus host.ini are the whole settings flow
findings.fix: add a labelled 设置 surface, or state in product docs that the inline commands are it

findings.expected: each command has an Alt access key
findings.fix: add &-mnemonics to the main command texts

findings.expected: Shift+Tab visits the same stops in reverse
findings.actual: not measurable while KB-07 traps the walk

confirmed_working: bookshelf list exposes a name, list role, keyboard focus and one accessible name per row
a book imports with the keyboard only (path typed, Space on 导入, shelf grows)
reading region reachable with Tab after 17 stops and shows a visible focus rectangle (1390 changed pixels, 3 of 3 samples)
arrows turn pages and the position line exposes 章/页/字号
Ctrl+A and Ctrl+C select and copy 432 bytes from the keyboard
annotation add, jump and delete work from the keyboard
字号 change 150 -> 160 and host.ini FontPercent=160
fixed-page zoom: 字号 disabled, 缩放 100 -> 125
details dialog: named 书籍详情, edits named 书名(T)/作者(A), 收藏 Alt+f with a toggle pattern, Tab cycle 书名->作者->收藏->保存->取消->书名, Escape closes, Enter runs the default 保存
shelf search filters from the keyboard to 《Pages》 — 未知作者 · PDF
UIA focus agrees with GetGUIThreadInfo at every sampled stop
method: real packaged host, private data directory, keyboard input through SendInput, UIA read; no driver script and no WM_COMMAND injection; visible focus measured by PrintWindow pixel comparison

verification.recomputed: counts, blocking set, audit_completed and accessibility_accepted re-derived from the 49 named checks

limitations: automated UIA and injected input are not a screen-reader acceptance; no NVDA/Narrator/human pass was run
speech output, verbosity, pronunciation and reading order inside a page are not judged
two blocking defects take the audit off the keyboard path; focus was restored through the auditor's own thread attach (6 recoveries, 20 trap escapes) and every one is in the key trace
only the fixed Win32 host at this source is audited; iOS, Android, GTK, sync and network features are out of scope
human_review_required: NVDA and Narrator pass over the same flows on a real Windows desktop
reading order and speech quality of the page region once a text provider exists
confidence check that no control needs a mouse

clear the import field before the second book; the fixtures path was still relative
